name: smwgraphics-custom-super-mario-bros
title: Custom Super Mario Bros. 2 Shy Guy, Snifit, Beezo and Tweeter
description:
Original graphic replacements for the following sprites:
  • SMB2 Shyguy + Giant Shyguy
  • SMB2 Snifit + Giant Snifit
  • Beezo + Giant Beezo
  • Tweeter + Giant Tweeter

May or may not be compatible with other sprite adaptations of these enemies.

Additional information in the readme file. Credit is optional, but appreciated.
